skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and role of managerial accounting, distinguish between managerial and financial accounting, and identify types of costs for decision-making.
Analyze the relationship between costs, volume, and profit; understand break-even analysis and profit targets.
Develop cost standards and production budgeting systems; analyze variances between actual and budgeted figures.
Proficient in working independently and in teams.
Take responsibility for personal learning outcomes.
